useCase: Identifying 딥페이크s through 반사 이상 in eyes, glasses, and reflective surfaces
mechanism: 분석합니다 specular highlights and 반사s in eyes, glasses, and other reflective surfaces for consistency with the environment. AI 생성 videos frequently produce incorrect corneal 반사s, mismatched specular highlights, or physically impossible 반사 패턴.
source: Hu, S. et al. (2021) - Exposing GAN-generated Faces Using Inconsistent Corneal Specular Highlights, ICASSP

parameters: Eye 감지: landmark-based, Reflection extraction: 임계값ing + clustering, Consistency: 상관관계
